issues: 标题是 34px 设计坐标放大的普通无衬线白字，文案是 “Your headline goes here” 占位，画面像模板截图
构图只有居中两行字，上下大片死黑，暂停任一帧都不像设计过的版面
主副标题只差字号，没有字体家族、颜色或强调词带来的层级
背景是纯平深灰，没有光、空间和材质
副标题落定后画面完全静止，尾段是死帧
changes: 换 paper look（暖白纸 · 墨 · 朱红）做编辑排版海报：刊头/刊脚发丝线框成一页，左对齐 168px 网格
层级重做：朱红全大写眉题 → 170px 衬线两行主标题 “Make every launch / feel inevitable.”（主角词斜体朱红）→ 46px 无衬线副标题
保留三通道共用同一个 p 的核心手法，改成 EASE.out 曲线、dy 0.38em、blur 18px；第二行先停 6f 换气，主角词入场窗加长到 30f 并在同一个 p 上收紧字距，最后落定
副标题 9 词 2.4f 错峰、位移/模糊减半，与主标题重叠 26f 读作一句话
后景加 760px 刊号数字（5% 墨色）从虚焦显影并反向慢漂，与文字层极缓推近 1→1.03 形成视差
hold 段不死：72f 起刊脚发丝线从右向左画出 + 页码淡入，纸面主光极缓呼吸
issuesEn: The headline was plain white sans scaled up from 34px design units, with placeholder copy “Your headline goes here” — it read like a template screenshot
The composition was just two centered lines with large dead black areas; no paused frame looked like a designed layout
Title and subtitle differed only in size — no type-family, colour or emphasis-word hierarchy
The background was flat dark grey with no light, depth or material
Once the subtitle landed the frame went completely still, leaving a dead tail
changesEn: Switched to the paper look (warm paper, ink, vermilion) as an editorial poster: masthead and footer hairlines frame a page on a left-aligned 168px grid
New hierarchy: vermilion all-caps kicker → 170px two-line serif headline “Make every launch / feel inevitable.” (italic vermilion hero word) → 46px sans subtitle

Kept the core move — all three channels on one shared p — now on EASE.out with 0.38em travel and 18px blur; line two breathes 6f first, and the hero word gets a 30f window with tracking tightening on the same p, landing last
Nine-word subtitle staggered at 2.4f with half the travel/blur, overlapping the headline by 26f so it reads as one sentence
A 760px issue numeral (5% ink) resolves from defocus in the background and drifts the opposite way while the text layer pushes 1→1.03, giving parallax
The hold stays alive: from 72f a footer hairline draws right-to-left with a page number, and the paper key light breathes slowly
